scope: Categories, services, business details, photos and updates that accurately represent the business.
Keep the business name, address and phone number aligned across the website and important directories.
Review relevant directory mentions, correct conflicting details and address duplicate listings where possible.
Build a practical review-request and response process, with attention to genuine feedback and platform policies.
Connect service and location information to useful pages, clear contact details and appropriate business markup.
Document listing changes, review local visibility and use the findings to prioritize the next improvements.
